title: Donkey Kong Country

widgets.text: 100 bananas give an extra life; a balloon gives one too. Lose your partner Kong on a hit; with one Kong left, the next hit costs a life. DK barrels bring the partner back.

Donkey Kong: heavy, defeats Klumps and Krushas by jumping, strong hand-slap on the ground (Down+B on flat ground). Diddy Kong: faster, jumps higher, cartwheel attack, but cannot beat heavy enemies by jumping on them.

widgets.label: Boss tips
rows: Kongo Jungle: jump on it as it hops; five hits.
Monkey Mines: bounce on its head when it leans out to spit nuts.
Vine Valley: throw barrels at it; it turns red and rushes after each hit.
Gorilla Glacier: like Very Gnawty but jumps higher and shakes icicles loose.
Kremkroc: defeat the enemies it drops, then it falls after the last wave.
Chimp Caverns: same pattern as Master Necky, faster spit.
Gang-Plank Galleon: jump on his head after the crown throw; beware the fake ending.

widgets.text: Kongo Jungle, Monkey Mines, Vine Valley, Gorilla Glacier, Kremkroc Industries and Chimp Caverns lead to Gang-Plank Galleon. Candy saves your game, Cranky gives hints, Funky flies you between worlds.
Three tokens of the same animal open its bonus stage when the level ends: collect tokens there for extra lives.
Bonus rooms hide behind walls you break with rolling or barrel throws, and in barrel cannons off the main path. The percentage on the file goes up with every bonus room found.
Beat all six bosses and K. Rool on Gang-Plank Galleon for the ending; 101% needs every bonus room.
